precision_limitation_rationale: Cannot compute precision without an independently labeled ground-truth collaboration dataset. Ratio of handle-verified rows in candidate sample is a heuristic match rate, not empirical precision.
recall_limitation_rationale: Cannot compute catalog-wide recall across 96420 historical videos because titles are available for only 581 records, video descriptions remain unindexed, and unflagged streams lack ground-truth participant rosters. Stating completeness is scientifically invalid without full-catalog labels.
